حَطْمَةٌ The crowding, thronging, or pressing, of men; and their pushing one another. (TA.) ―
-b2- The tide (دُفْعَة) of a torrent; like طَحْمَةٌ. (S.) ―
-b3- The havoc of a lion among cattle. (TA.) ―
-b4- (tropical:) Dearth, drought, or sterility; or a year of dearth, &c.; (S, K, TA;) because it breaks (تَحْطِمُ) everything; (TA;) as also ↓ حُطْمَةٌ and ↓ حَاطُومٌ : (K:) or this last is not used except as meaning continual dearth &c. (TA.) [See also the last of these words below.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
